summary: This video showcases high-performing Toxin team configurations against the endgame boss Mekkatorque in the Rasp of Gears event. Gorax demonstrates both high-inspiration and inspiration 0 setups, highlighting a primary Lothair team alongside a Child of Chaos alternative for players lacking Lothair. Detailed hero stat priorities, gear sets, stat-sharing synergies (Resistance, Accuracy, Attack), and precise ultimate skill timings are provided to achieve maximum damage.

heroes.name: Lothair
heroes.note: Delivers immense single-target damage against Mekkatorque in fully optimized Toxin setups.

heroes.name: Serpentemis
heroes.note: Requires high Enlightenment, Attack, and Resistance; must have higher Enlightenment than Lothair to claim the Lava Batwing familiar buff.

heroes.name: Sleight
heroes.note: Equipped with Shell of Gilded Doom artifact and high Attack to share stats via Everburning Netherfire gear.

heroes.name: Twitch
heroes.note: Built with Misty Conch for Defense Penalty and max Accuracy to share with teammates via the Bone Resonance set.

heroes.name: Blah Blah
heroes.note: Built with Haste gear and high Resistance to share 20% Resistance with adjacent allies via Stand United.

heroes.name: Child of Chaos
heroes.note: Provides Control Immunity and Ethereal team buffs, allowing teams to survive and deal heavy damage without Lothair.

teams.note: Primary Toxin team capable of reaching billions in damage against Mekkatorque.
Budget/alternative Toxin team substituting Lothair with Child of Chaos for superior team survival.

tips: Ensure Serpentemis has higher Enlightenment than Lothair so the Lava Batwing familiar buff targets her.
Stack maximum Accuracy on Twitch so he triggers the Bone Resonance set and shares Accuracy with the rest of the team.
Build high Resistance on Blah Blah to share 20% of his Resistance with adjacent allies via Stand United.
Use standard initial skill timings (Twitch 12.0s, Serpentemis ~9.4s, Sleight ~11.8s, Blah Blah ~12.2s) and let recasts remain on default.
title: Best Toxin Team vs Mekkatorque | Rasp of Gears S8 | Dragonheir x Dragonstride
